Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.experimenters

package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.experimenters
This package contains OMERO entities related to permissions:
  • OmeroExperimenter represents an OMERO experimenter.
  • OmeroExperimenterGroup represents an OMERO group.
